name: changing project
description: An invented project over six weeks, in which the person takes part: a storage decision, a rejected proposal, a version migration that breaks a verified procedure and brings a new one, and a report that stays unresolved. Repeated dreams with nothing new at the end.

records.author: build lead
records.title: Quillmoss storage decision
records.text: Decision for the Quillmoss project: we store job state in Burrowdb, pinned to Burrowdb 4.2. Reason: it is the only store our deploy tooling already supports, and the team knows it. This is decided, not a proposal.

records.author: ops engineer
records.title: Quillmoss schema upgrade runbook (Burrowdb 4)
records.text: Schema upgrade procedure for Quillmoss on Burrowdb 4.2: run `quillmoss migrate --online` against the live store, then restart the workers one at a time. Verified on the staging cluster on 2031-03-04: the upgrade finished, and the post-upgrade check suite passed 40 of 40 checks.

questions.question: Which database does Quillmoss store its job state in, and which version?
How do we upgrade the Quillmoss schema?
questions.expectedAnswer: Run quillmoss migrate --online against the live store, then restart the workers one at a time; verified on staging with 40 of 40 checks passing.

questions.question: What is the Quillmoss disaster recovery target?

records.author: ops engineer
records.text: Idea: should Quillmoss move its job state from Burrowdb to Ferrox? Ferrox has built-in replication. Just a thought, nothing decided.

records.author: build lead
records.text: Maybe. Let's look at it next week before anyone changes anything.

records.author: @you
records.text: Agreed, nobody changes the store until we have looked at Ferrox properly.

records.author: build lead
records.text: Follow-up on Ferrox: we looked at it and we are not moving to Ferrox. Our deploy tooling does not support it and replication is not a need we have. Quillmoss stays on Burrowdb. Proposal rejected.

questions.question: Which database does Quillmoss store its job state in?
questions.expectedAnswer: Burrowdb. Moving to Ferrox was proposed on 2031-03-10 and rejected on 2031-03-17.

questions.question: Did Quillmoss adopt Ferrox?
questions.expectedAnswer: No. Ferrox was proposed and then rejected: the deploy tooling does not support it and replication is not needed.

records.author: build lead
records.title: Quillmoss moves to Burrowdb 5
records.text: Decision: Quillmoss moves from Burrowdb 4.2 to Burrowdb 5.1, effective 2031-04-07. Reason: Burrowdb 4 reaches end of support in May 2031. After 2031-04-07 no Quillmoss environment runs Burrowdb 4.

records.author: ops engineer
records.text: Tried the usual schema upgrade on staging after the move to Burrowdb 5.1: `quillmoss migrate --online` hangs at the lock step and never finishes. Burrowdb 5 no longer allows online schema changes while writers are connected. Do not use the online upgrade on Burrowdb 5.

records.author: @you
records.text: Thanks. Hold all schema upgrades until we have a procedure that works on Burrowdb 5.

records.author: ops engineer
records.text: Unrelated: `quillmoss status` exits 0 on staging, the CLI works.

records.author: ops engineer
records.text: New procedure for Burrowdb 5: drain the workers with `quillmoss drain`, run `quillmoss migrate --offline`, then start the workers again. Verified on staging on 2031-04-09: the upgrade finished and the post-upgrade check suite passed 40 of 40 checks.

questions.question: Which Burrowdb version does Quillmoss run now?
questions.expectedAnswer: Burrowdb 5.1, since 2031-04-07; before that it was 4.2.

questions.question: Why did Quillmoss move to Burrowdb 5?
questions.expectedAnswer: Because Burrowdb 4 reaches end of support in May 2031.

questions.question: How do we upgrade the Quillmoss schema now?
questions.expectedAnswer: On Burrowdb 5: drain the workers with quillmoss drain, run quillmoss migrate --offline, then start the workers again; verified on staging with 40 of 40 checks. The online upgrade hangs on Burrowdb 5 and must not be used.
questions.outdatedAnswer: quillmoss migrate --online, then restart the workers one at a time.

questions.question: What should we avoid when upgrading the Quillmoss schema on Burrowdb 5?
questions.expectedAnswer: The online upgrade, quillmoss migrate --online: it hangs at the lock step because Burrowdb 5 does not allow online schema changes while writers are connected.

questions.question: Does quillmoss status exiting 0 show that the schema upgrade on Burrowdb 5 works?
questions.expectedAnswer: No. It only shows the CLI runs; the upgrade was shown to work by the offline procedure's 40 of 40 passing checks.

questions.question: Which Burrowdb version did Quillmoss run in early March 2031?

records.author: support engineer
records.text: The Quillmoss daily export might be failing since the Burrowdb 5 move, two customers said their files were empty. Not confirmed yet.

records.author: @you
records.text: Can someone check yesterday's export files before we tell the customers anything?

records.author: ops engineer
records.text: Checked one of the exports from yesterday: it had rows. Can't tell yet whether the empty files are real. Still open.

questions.expectedAnswer: Unresolved: empty files were reported by two customers but not confirmed, and one export checked had rows.
